speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any mucus? If so, what color is the mucus and how much do you cough up? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Right lower lobe consolidation consistent with a possible pneumonia. No pleural effusion noted.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the results; the consolidation in your right lower lobe strongly suggests pneumonia. To determine if there is any bacterial superinfection or underlying structural issue, have you been experiencing any high fevers or chills, and do you have a history of smoking? REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: That is good news regarding the blood culture, but the chest X-ray remains concerning. Besides the fever and chills, have you noticed any weight loss, night sweats, or coughing up blood? REQUEST TEST: Tuberculin_Skin_Test

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal tuberculin skin test makes tuberculosis less likely, but we still need to rule out other causes. Have you recently traveled to an area with endemic fungi, and do you have any known allergies or a history of asthma? REQUEST TEST: Fungal_Serology

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative workup for TB, fungi, and normal blood cultures, have you been recently exposed to a sick contact, and do you have any underlying lung conditions like COPD or emphysema? REQUEST TEST: Sputum_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Right Lower Lobe)
